title: Walnut and gold gaming pit railing
summary: Dark walnut uprights and polished gold brass rails frame the gaming pit under the warm casino lights.
notes: Add a Blockbench-authored low-poly railing with walnut shafts and polished gold brass crossbars, bases and caps.
Place shared railing spans and posts around the gaming pit in editable GridMaps, keeping both ramp openings clear.
Use a single small atlas and light-responsive finish without adding more lights.
